notes:
Prospect summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer analytics + in-app search).

Initial thesis: team wants fast time-to-value with Hosted API for prod pilot, then move to Dedicated once usage predictable and legal residency locked. Primary drivers: EU data residency, consistent latency for EU customers, predictable token economics for peak hours.

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-11-05: Intro call (Maya) — product goals; asked about EU region availability.
- 2025-12-10: NDA signed; shared security FAQ and SOC2 artifacts.
- 2026-01-12: Technical discovery w/ infra + SRE (Jasper) — discussed KV cache, seq length, expected p95 latency targets 120-200ms.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of Hosted API (streaming/prompt templates) — Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_0918. Good engagement; product likes streaming for live help widget.
- 2026-03-02: Pricing & capacity call — showed dedicated pricing bands and burst options; product asks for EU-only storage clause. Fireflies: ff_2026-03-02_1405.

POC details / tech notes:
- Workload: primarily doc search + contextual support chat (short context windows ~256-512 tokens).
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for EU customers; can tolerate 300ms for non-critical background jobs.
- Throughput: steady 10-30 reqs/sec during business hours; spikes to 80-120 reqs/sec for campaign windows.
- Model preference: open-models ok; prefer smaller quantized variants for cost; fallback model in other region acceptable if routed properly.
- Routing: want EU primary, with multi-region fallback to US only if EU capacity exhausted; ask about warm KV cache and cross-region cache invalidation.

Commercial / Procurement notes:
- Hosted API used for pilot — procurement prefers to start here to avoid CAPEX and accelerate product launch.
- Commitment threshold for Dedicated estimated at 75k-150k ARR depending on discounts and SLOs.
- Key ask: show cost delta and latency delta for EU-hosted vs Dedicated-EU vs Dedicated-global. Need a pricing sheet that models token-based usage + reserved GPU hours. Shared drive: drive:/deals/euclid-poc-tech-reqs.xlsx

Security & legal:
- Must support EU data residency; legal requests explicit clause for data-at-rest location for customer PII and derivatives.
- Requires SSO (SAML) for Console and audit logging accessible to their auditors. KMS integration for keys mandatory for Dedicated.
